Overview.Name: Pavan Kumar Pydimukkala
Overview.Goal: Fat loss, better appearance, increased energy, confidence, health improvement, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + 2 boiled eggs
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat curd (150 g)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (200 ml)
Breakfast: Option 1: Omelette (3 eggs) with vegetables (50 g) + small bowl curd (100 g)
Option 2: Boiled eggs (3) + rice poha (80 g)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + curd (150 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + chicken curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + fish curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + leafy vegetable fry (100 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + mutton curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (30 g) with boiled chickpeas (50 g) + cucumber (50 g)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (30 g) + small fruit (100 g)
Option 3: Boiled egg whites (2 eggs) + small fruit (100 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Egg curry (3 eggs) + small rice (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Dal (200 g) + rice (100 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable fry (100 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + dal (150 g) + curd (100 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Non-veg at lunch 4-5 times per week is sufficient - lighter dinner with eggs, paneer, or dal supports fat loss.
Sweet cravings: you control desserts well - use this strength at social gatherings.
Fried cravings: add ghee or butter to dal/vegetables for satisfaction without deep frying.
Spicy cravings: add green chilies or pepper to regular meals.
Boredom eating: keep puffed rice, makhana, or boiled eggs ready instead of fried snacks.
Social gatherings: eat your meal before going, then take only small portions.
